يغتفروا (form VIII)
# يَغْتَفِرُوا (yaḡtafirū) /jaɣ.ta.fi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# يُغْتَفَرُوا (yuḡtafarū) /juɣ.ta.fa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
